privacy.title: Mutemo Wekuvanzika
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets inounganidza ruzivo rudiki rwemunhu runodiwa pakugadzira akaunti nekuwana premium, kusanganisira maemail uye ruzivo rwekubhadhara runobatwa zvakachengeteka kuburikidza neStripe (web) neGoogle Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: Tinoshandisa ruzivo rwako kupa mukana kumazano edu ekubheja, kubhadhara, uye kutonga hurongwa hwekukokera vanhu. Hatitengesi ruzivo rwako rwemunhu kumapato echitatu.
privacy.s3Body: Tinoshandisa nzira dzekuchengetedza dzemhando yepamusoro kuburikidza neSupabase, Stripe, Google Play neRevenueCat kuchengetedza ruzivo rwako. Zvisinei, hapana nzira yekutumira paInternet yakachengeteka 100%.
privacy.s4Body: Kana uine mibvunzo nezve Mutemo uyu weZvakavanzika, bata nesu pa greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Mitemo yeSevhisi
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets inopa mazano ekubheja eruzivo nemasurebets. Hatipe masevhisi ekubheja kana zano rezvemari. Zviitiko zvese zvekubheja ndezve njodzi yako.
terms.s2Body: Kuwana Premium kunopihwa kuburikidza nekunyoresa pa Android (Google Play, inogadziriswa neRevenueCat) uye kutenga kamwe chete pawebhu (inogadziriswa neStripe). Kunyoresa kweGoogle Play kunoenderana nemitemo yekubhadhara nekudzorera mari yeGoogle Play. Kutenga pawebhu hakuchinjike kana mukana wapihwa.
terms.s3Body: Sisitimu yedu yekutumira vanhu yakagadzirirwa kushandiswa wega. Kushandisa zvisizvo, kusanganisira kuzvitumira wega kana kugadzira account nehunyengeri, kuchaita kuti account yako imiswe uye urasikirwe nemabhonasi.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets haivimbisi kuhwina. Maitiro ekare haaratidzi mhedzisiro yemberi. Gara uchibheja zvine mutoro.

deletion.title: Kudzimwa kweAccount neData
deletion.intro: PaGreat Sport Bets, tinoremekedza zvakavanzika zvako uye tinopa nzira yakajeka yekudzima account yako nedata rako pachako.
deletion.warningBody: Kudzima account yako ndekwechigarire. Ucharasikirwa nekukwanisa kuwana Premium yako, mabhonasi ekutumira vanhu, uye nhoroondo. Chiito ichi hachigone kudzoserwa.
deletion.step1: Tumira email kuna <email>{{email}}</email> uchibva paemail address yakabatana neaccount yako yeGreat Sport Bets.
deletion.step3: Chikumbiro chako chichagadziriswa mukati memazuva 7 ekushanda. Uchawana email yekusimbisa kana kudzimwa kwapera.
deletion.deleted2: Marekodhi ekuwana Premium uye nhoroondo yekubhadhara
deletion.deleted3: Malink ekutumira vanhu, makodhi, uye nhoroondo
deletion.keptBody: Nekuda kwekutevedzera mutemo nezvemari (semuenzaniso, kushuma mutero wekubhadhara kweStripe neGoogle Play), tinogona kuchengeta maID ekutengeserana nemametadata kwemakore anosvika mashanu. Data iyi haina kubatanidzwa nehunhu hwako uye inoshandiswa chete kuongorora.
